title: Right index under successor embedding
statement: Let $r,k$ be nonnegative integers and let $j\in\{0,\ldots,k-1\}$. The right index associated with the successor embedding of $j$ into the next finite index set is the image, under the natural inclusion that adds two coordinates, of the right index associated with $j$; that is, $r+2(j+1)+1$ in the larger coordinate set corresponds to $r+2j+1$ in the original set.
